=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1709-1711 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `Integration branch:` and `Target branch:` regexes use `re.MULTILINE` with `^\s*` prefix and lazy-quantified value groups followed by ambiguous whitespace alternatives. A crafted issue body with many blank lines causes quadratic backtracking; a single label line with a long whitespace run inside the value causes cubic backtracking.
  WHY: Both the sweep (`close_merged_issues_sweep` at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3998`) and `issue_pr_status.yml` call this helper on issue bodies that anyone can submit, and the PR-close step has a five-minute job timeout. A body with 60,000 blank lines could keep the `python3 -c` subprocess busy for tens of seconds (measured before: 7.0 s at 16,000 lines). A single label line with 5,000 spaces took 29.7 s. This is the DoS vector that security audit #3576 filed as issue #4956. The fix (a linear-time line-by-line string parser) is tracked by plan `docs/plans/issue-4956-linear-issue-branch-parser-plan.md` and is not yet in this PR.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: issue_body_integration_branch() lines 1693-1707 — re.search with re.MULTILINE on untrusted issue body | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The two re.MULTILINE regexes (INTEGRATION_BRANCH_LINE_RE and TARGET_BRANCH_LINE_RE) exhibit super-linear backtracking on pathological inputs.
  WHY: The security audit of this branch filed #4956 (STRIDE Denial of Service, severity medium, confidence 9/10): a body with 16,000 blank lines takes ~7 s, and a single label line with 2,000 spaces takes ~29.7 s. close_merged_issues_sweep and issue_pr_status.yml call this helper on issue bodies that anyone who can open or edit an issue controls, under a 5-minute job timeout. A crafted issue body can cause the Python regex engine to consume the entire job timeout, blocking the workflow step. The same regexes already exist in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:46-63 and scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1696-1707, so the DoS surface is not new to the codebase, but this PR introduces a new call site on the PR-close path. The #4956 plan (included in this PR as docs/plans/issue-4956-linear-issue-branch-parser-plan.md) replaces these regexes with a linear parser, but the fix is not yet implemented in this PR.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
